profile.summaryJa: 列王記下6:24は、ベン・ハダドをアラムの王として挙げ、全軍を集めてサマリアを包囲したと記します。
profile.identityNoteJa: 本文はアラム王ベン・ハダドを名指します。

facts.textJa: 列王記下8:7では、ダマスカスにいたエリシャのもとへ、病気のベン・ハダド王の知らせが届きます。
ハザエルはベン・ハダドの使いとしてエリシャに会い、病から回復するかを尋ねました。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.
Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”

So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

review.identityCheckJa: 2 Kings 6:24 names an Aramean king Benhadad, while 8:7–9 names another Benhadad; the text itself does not explicitly state whether these are the same individual.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: L137–141 describes Hadadezer, possibly Ben-Hadad II, as king of Aram-Damascus and connects the biblical Ben-Hadad in 2 Kings 8 with Hazael’s succession. This supports a relation to the 8:7 referent but does not establish the identity of the 6:24 king.
